description: Connector backlog for sources not covered by current Yandex Direct/Metrika/Wordstat APIs.

connectors.reason: No separate local form backend or CRM pipeline is used; Direct-hosted forms are measured by Metrika form_submit goals.
Optional actual Yandex/TurboPage contact-card export. Lead count and CPA use Metrika form-submit goal reaches; this connector is not required for zero/positive lead counting.
CRM is intentionally out of scope: expensive product, manual lead handling, no CRM system.
Call tracking is intentionally out of scope: no phone lead workflow.
Direct-hosted TurboPages/client-site landing content cannot be parsed from this repository without a Direct artifact, saved snapshot, or dedicated read-only landing fetcher.
Yandex Webmaster is not technically applicable to Direct-hosted TurboPages/client landing pages.
Wordstat volume does not prove buyer intent; SERP validation is needed for new clusters.
RСЯ placement quality needs external categorization beyond raw Direct/Metrika metrics.
